spans.s: --the Asura who insulted the sage Udaka and met with death at the hands of कुवलयाश्व. Vi.
IV. 2
(I)--the son of Andhaka and father of Daridyota (Aridyota-ब्र्। प्।). भा. IX. २४. २०.
(II)--a son of द्युतिमान्; a Janapada in क्रौञ्चद्वीप called after him; दुन्दुभिदेश. Br. II. १४. २३, २६; वा. ३३. २१, २३. Vi.
II. 4
(IV)--Mt. one of the seven hills of प्लक्ष- द्वीप where Dundubhi and the Asura चन्द्रमृत्यु were beaten by the Devas. Br. II. १८. ७५; १९. १०; Vi.
(V)--one of the Danu's sons; a दानव. Br.
III. 6. 4
(VI)--a son of Maya and रम्भा. Br.
III. 6
(VII)--a musical instrument whose sound causes death; used in the तारकामय. M. १७७. २६.
(VIII)--Mt. in शाकद्वीप; here the Devas once beat the drum, the sound of which caused death to Dundubhi and from thence took this name. M. १२२. १३-14.
(IX)--a son of सुतार, the Lord of the sacred द्वापर. वा. २३. १२१.
(X)--(Sata Dundubhi?) a son of Jambha. वा. ६७. ७८.
(III)--Mt. a hill of क्रौञ्चद्वीप; also a region, a वर्ष of the द्वीपम्. Br. II. १४. २६; १९. ६९, ७३; वा. ४९. ६३, ६८; Vi.
II. 4
--a name of कुवलयाश्व, (s.v.). Vi.
